title: Underwater video
summary: Seal checks before, controls during, rinse after.

blocks.note: Touchscreens don't work fully under water. Set everything up first.

steps: Check every seal and door is clean and closed.
Set mode and settings on dry land, then start recording before you go under.
Stay shallow: colours and light fade quickly with depth.
Get close to the subject; water softens everything far away.
Rinse in fresh water afterwards and let it dry.
**Depth:** 20 m on its own, 60 m in the Osmo Action 60 m waterproof case. Not waterproof with the lens hood fitted.
**Before:** battery and compartment dry and clean, battery door fully closed with **no red marks showing**. USB-C cover and lens cover on tight, seals clean.
Case? Leave it under water for about 5 minutes first to check it, add an anti-fog insert, and make sure the latch is closed.
Set the mode and settings on land. **The touchscreens don't work fully submerged.** Start and stop with the **Shutter/Record** button.
Without the case, the Shutter/Record button stops working below 10 m, so start recording before you go deeper.
Don't jump in at speed holding it; the impact can force water in. No hot springs or chemicals.
**After:** rinse in tap water (case too, after the sea) and let it air-dry. **No hair dryer**: it ruptures the waterproof membranes. Open the battery door facing down and wipe the red seal.
dji-osmo-action-5-pro.note: To log depth, turn on control menu › Settings › Depth & Altitude › Diving. DJI Mimo can show it on the video.
